title: What a lunar landing attempt costs

rows.label: Headline
rows.value: A single lunar landing attempt typically costs on the order of $100 million.
rows.quote: Order-of-magnitude statement supported by Beresheet (~$100M), Peregrine ($107.9M task order) and IM-1 ($122.0M task order); counter-examples: Chandrayaan-3 (~$30M excl. launch) and IM-2 PRIME-1 ($50.0M).

source.label: NASA OIG IG-24-013, NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services Initiative

rows.note: Not a rule: costs range from about $30M to about $140M among documented attempts.

source.label: AP via Star-Advertiser, Israeli moon mission fails
